g.text: Same hardware: X, early manual braking and late manual braking
Bench 350 bar, 600 L mass setting; all begin at CG 0.597 m. Early manual: E 0-0.792 s; Z 0.792-1.800 s; then G.
Late 355-degree release overshoots 410 degrees. G physically finishes/brakes the turn and levels; manual has no automatic return to ground.
